mapper.select: INSERT INTO iam_oauth_clients (display_name, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.displayName}, #{row.allowedScopes, typeHandler=io.saasforge.iam.infrastructure.persistence.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{row.clientStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, display_name, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, revoked_at

INSERT INTO iam_oauth_clients (id, display_name, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.displayName}, #{row.allowedScopes, typeHandler=io.saasforge.iam.infrastructure.persistence.type.StringArrayTypeHandler}, #{row.clientStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, display_name, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, revoked_at

INSERT INTO iam_oauth_client_secrets (client_id, secret_digest, created_at, valid_until, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.clientId}, #{row.secretDigest}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.validUntil}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, client_id, secret_digest, created_at, valid_until, revoked_at

SELECT client.id, client.display_name, client.allowed_scopes, client.client_status, client.created_at, client.revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients client JOIN iam_oauth_client_secrets secret ON secret.client_id = client.id WHERE secret.secret_digest = #{secretDigest} AND client.client_status = 'ACTIVE' AND secret.revoked_at IS NULL AND (secret.valid_until IS NULL OR secret.valid_until > #{at})
SELECT id, display_name, allowed_scopes, client_status, created_at, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_clients WHERE id = #{clientId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, client_id, secret_digest, created_at, valid_until, revoked_at FROM iam_oauth_client_secrets WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY created_at, id
